prompts.E: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: sophisticated Sagittarius constellation engraving concept for a 400 x 400 mm acrylic lamp. Reference image 1 is the EXACT fixed gold constellation network on a square board, reference image 2 is the same graph labeled with HIP IDs only for placement; NEVER copy its numeric labels into the artwork. Artistically design a beautiful anatomically convincing adult mythic CENTAUR archer AROUND this given constellation rather than overlaying an unrelated stock centaur. Retain all existing 21 gold star positions and 24 connections in their original relative locations, do not rotate/mirror/rearrange the constellation, do not add extra stars or gold links. The gold structure must visibly belong to the archer's bow, arms, torso, horse body or flowing mantle. New engraving is delicate silver-white linework only, composed entirely of carefully chosen short and long STRAIGHT SEGMENTS; a contour can approximate organic anatomy with many elegant straight facets. Artistic grace, credible face, hands, muscular proportions and a coherent pose take priority over minimizing segment count. Not a child's cartoon, not a stick figure, not a stock triangle mesh. Flat midnight-navy square canvas with thin square board boundary, plenty of quiet negative space; no text, no render of a photograph, no 3D metallic fill, no shading areas, no decorative stars, no arbitrary surrounding ornaments. GOLD = original constellation; SILVER-WHITE = engraving contour and restrained anatomical details. The original graph should remain dominant and beautifully integrated. Direction E: 'turning star archer'. Noble classical centaur upper body in the TOP RIGHT, turning back to shoot LEFT-UP. The existing chain HIP95168 (79,62),94820(106,71),93683(145,89) lies nearly on the straight arrow axis toward the left; extend the arrow shaft through HIP92041(215,121), without moving the stars. HIP92041 is around the draw hand or arrow nock; upper right gold triangles form shoulder, drawing arm and chest, 90496(253,87) near neck, 89931(285,129) near upper arm and 88635(324,121) near elbow. High isolated 89341(270,14) can be a tasteful long helmet plume, not a floating star. Horse body spans the middle of the square: hips near 96406(84,165), back toward93864(166,159), upper horse chest around93506(186,178)/90185(295,187). The dramatic left-lower gold chain 98688(40,238)->98412(90,317)->98032(140,386) is a magnificent LONG SWEEPING HORSE TAIL, with95347/95294 as two tapering tail tips, drawn in sparse graceful faceted ribbons. Four recognizably horse-shaped legs occupy the lower central/right empty area, lifted or poised, avoiding visual tangles with the tail. Long diagonal arrow, expressive classical male face, tapered limbs, strong waist-to-horse fusion. The bow is around the left half of the upper star group and visibly gripped. Make a refined celestial engraving, not a technical diagram.
